'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Mali War]]
**At least 33 soldiers are killed and 14 others are wounded in an attack on a [[Malian Armed Forces|military]] post in [[Gao]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/3/17/at-least-33-killed-in-northern-mali-attack (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Internal conflict in Myanmar]]
**Nearly 200 civilians, mostly [[Catholic]]s, are forced to flee their villages due to renewed fighting between the military and the [[Kachin Independence Army]] (KIA) in [[Myanmar]]’s conflict-stricken [[Kachin State|Kachin state]]. [https://www.ucanews.com/news/hundreds-of-kachins-flee-fighting-in-northern-myanmar/91792 (UCA News)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Kazakhstan]]
****[[Kazakhstan]] suspends talks with [[AstraZeneca]] for purchasing [[Oxford–AstraZeneca COVID-19 vaccine|its vaccine]] amidst fears of blood clots in many countries. [https://finance.yahoo.com/news/kazakhstan-suspends-talks-buying-astrazeneca-121924101.html (Reuters via ''Yahoo! News'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Lebanon]]
****[[Lebanon]] suspends the use of the [[Oxford-AstraZeneca COVID-19 vaccine|Oxford-AstraZeneca]] [[COVID-19 vaccine|vaccine]] pending a review from the international health agencies following fears of blood clots in [[vaccination|vaccinated]] people. [http://www.naharnet.com/stories/en/280176-hassan-lebanon-suspends-astrazeneca-vaccine-pending-intl-investigation (Naharnet)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the State of Palestine]]
****The [[Palestinian National Authority]] receives 61,440 doses of the [[COVID-19]] [[vaccine]]. 37,440 of the doses are the [[Pfizer-BioNTech COVID-19 vaccine|Pfizer-BioNTech vaccine]] and the other 24,000 doses are the Oxford-AstraZeneca vaccine. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/palestinian-authority-set-to-receive-61440-vaccine-doses-through-who-program/ (''The Times of Israel'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Uzbekistan]]
****[[Uzbekistan]] receives its first shipment of 660,000 doses of the Oxford-AstraZeneca vaccine manufactured by the [[Serum Institute of India]] and distributed through the [[COVAX]] initiative. [https://m.akipress.com/news:655684:First_consignment_of_AstraZeneca_coronavirus_vaccine_arrives_in_Uzbekistan/ (AKI Press)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Hungary]]
****[[Hungary]] reports a record 195 deaths from COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide death toll to 17,421. [https://hungarytoday.hu/coronavirus-update-wednesday-195-fatalities-3456-more-infections/ (Hungary Today)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Poland]]
****The [[Government of Poland]] announces a new national [[COVID-19 lockdowns|lockdown]], which will close all cultural venues and non-essential shops for three weeks beginning on March 20 as the number of COVID-19 cases continues to increase. [https://www.politico.eu/article/poland-goes-into-near-lockdown-as-covid-19-pandemic-accelerates/ (''Politico.eu'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Ukraine]]
****[[Ukraine]] reports a record 289 deaths from COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, bringing the nationwide death toll to 28,986. [https://covid.unian.info/m/covid-19-in-ukraine-over-11-800-new-cases-reported-as-of-march-17-daily-deaths-hit-new-high-11355295.html (UNIAN)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in New York (state)]]
****[[Governor of New York|New York Governor]] [[Andrew Cuomo]] receives the [[Johnson & Johnson]] [[Johnson & Johnson COVID-19 vaccine|vaccine]]. [https://www.nydailynews.com/coronavirus/ny-nyc-covid-vaccine-cuomo-rangel-dukes-harlem-20210317-mxtm2e2ivfexbolofaewgzlfrq-story.html (''The New York Daily News'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in North Dakota]], [[variants of SARS-CoV-2]]
****[[North Dakota]] reports their first four cases of the [[Variants of SARS-CoV-2#Lineage B.1.429 / CAL.20C|California variant]] of [[Severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2|SARS-CoV-2]]. Additionally, the state also reports seven cases of the [[Lineage B.1.1.7|UK variant]] of SARS-CoV-2. [https://bismarcktribune.com/news/local/health/california-covid-19-variants-surface-in-north-dakota-state-also-confirms-more-cases-of-uk/article_b9655409-4f6f-5375-a3c6-349d229fb49f.html (''The Bismarck Tribune'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Brazil]]
***[[Brazil]] reports a record 90,303 new confirmed cases from COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, bringing the nationwide case total to 11,693,838. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-brazil-cases/brazil-reports-record-90000-new-covid-19-infections-a-day-after-setting-deadly-record-idUSKBN2B92ZA (Reuters)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Russia–United States relations]]
**[[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Joe Biden]] says that [[President of Russia|Russian president]] [[Vladimir Putin]] "will pay a price" for reportedly leading efforts to [[Russian interference in the 2020 United States elections|influence]] the [[2020 United States presidential election]] and that he has "no soul" and is "a killer". [https://www.rferl.org/a/biden-killer-putin-meddling-election/31155942.html (RFE/RL)]
**[[Russia]] recalls its [[Ambassador of Russia to the United States|Ambassador to the United States]] in order to figure out what to do and where to move in terms of relations with the U.S. [https://tass.com/politics/1267201 (TASS)]
*[[UNESCO]] Director General [[Audrey Azoulay]] is expected to be reelected as head of the agency after no other candidates were nominated. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-unesco-chief-usa/unesco-chief-set-for-new-term-eyes-u-s-return-official-idUSKBN2B91UO?il=0 (Reuters)]
*[[Pope Francis]] expresses his concerns over the tense situation in [[Paraguay]] due to a deepening health and political crisis in the South American nation which have led to [[2021 Paraguayan protests|protests]] and instances of violence in recent days. In his message, the Pope appeals for dialogue to prevail over violence. [https://www.vaticannews.va/en/pope/news/2021-03/pope-on-paraguay-may-dialogue-prevail-over-violence.html (Vatican News)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Same-sex marriage in Japan]]
**The [[Sapporo]] district court rules that prohibiting [[same-sex marriage]] is unconstitutional. [https://aljazeera.com/amp/news/2021/3/17/japan-court-makes-landmark-ruling-on-same-sex-marriage (Al Jazeera)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2021 Dutch general election]]
**The [[People's Party for Freedom and Democracy]] of incumbent [[Prime Minister of the Netherlands|Prime Minister]] [[Mark Rutte]] finishes first in the nation's general election. The liberal [[Democrats 66]] party is projected to equal their best-ever result, finishing second with 24 seats. A record of 17 parties are also in track to enter the [[House of Representatives (Netherlands)|House of Representatives]]. [https://www.dutchnews.nl/news/2021/03/dutch-vote-in-2021-general-election-live-blog/ (DutchNews.nl)]
**According to exit polls, turnout was at 82.6%, the highest since [[1986 Dutch general election|1986]]. [https://www.euronews.com/2021/03/17/mark-rutte-s-party-wins-most-seats-in-dutch-general-election-exit-poll-suggests (Euronews)]
*[[Politics of Tanzania]]
**[[President of Tanzania|President]] [[John Magufuli]] dies of heart complications, which are believed to have resulted from COVID-19. Vice President [[Samia Suluhu]] is expected to succeed him and become Tanzania's first female president. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/3/17/tanzanian-president-john-magufuli-is-dead-vp (Al Jazeera)]
